evidence_policy: Current battle observations and own status are facts; encyclopedia definitions are public reference evidence, not observed enemy equipment. Estimate identified-class threats from the supplied class and named encyclopedia weapons, citing those sources and distinguishing inference from observation. Actual enemy loadout, ammunition, damage, fuel, readiness and fire control are unknown; a reference weapon is not necessarily fitted, loaded, operational or firing. Retain configuration and identification uncertainty. Unknown posture is not hostile. Own ammunition includes zero and does not mean ready-to-fire rounds. Fuel not displayed for a unit type is neither zero nor full. Reference launch ranges do not prove current engagement feasibility: distinguish minimum/maximum and gun anti-air ranges, primary/secondary roles, horizon, visibility and guidance; secondary-role range may be unknown. Being outside one reference range does not establish safety. Armament coverage can be partial; no candidates does not prove an unarmed contact. Damage categories do not prove a specific weapon inoperable. Never invent ranges or capabilities from remembered history or names; missing reference evidence remains unknown. Terrain and current attack feasibility are not supplied. Only public objectives and displayed status disclose victory conditions; hidden scoring, enemy objectives and future events are unavailable. Contact positions are sensor estimates or extrapolations, not actual enemy positions. Observation time/error bounds may be unknown; capture time is not detection time. Hosted-aircraft inventory is unassigned stock, not the whole air wing or immediate readiness. Squadron counts, host occupancy, tasks and airborne aircraft overlap; do not sum them. Displayed task/status text is an observation, not an exact ready-time or launch-feasibility calculation. Loadout stock availability and nominal preparation time do not prove an immediate launch. A known opposing airbase is only a possible source, not evidence of hidden aircraft, reinforcements or scripted spawns.
retrieval: Before specific own-unit advice, batch get_unit_capabilities for current IDs and relevant enabled sections. Use get_contact_threats for identified-class threats. Retrieve hosted-aircraft details before recommending aircraft/loadouts; list_air_tasks supplies displayed preparation/recovery tasks. Use list_ground_units/get_ground_units and list_bases/get_bases for relevant own ground forces/facilities. Observed opposing facilities are contacts, optionally filtered by kind.
